setup.title: Install in three steps
setup.description: The manager has already looked for the game. Pick a set and install it — you see the full list before installing.
setup.gameMissingHint: If the game was not installed through Lesta Game Center, press “Choose a folder…” and pick the folder with Tanki.exe.
